name: r134a_compressor_minimum_power
title: R134a compressor minimum power, isentropic compression (Cengel 7-41)
summary: Saturated R134a vapour at 160 kPa is compressed to 900 kPa at an inlet volume flow of 2 m3/min. The minimum compressor power is the reversible adiabatic (isentropic) compression, from the steady-flow energy balance. Textbook exercise Cengel 7-41.
